answer: Identity-maturation timelock stops mass fakes. Each identity posts a bond in the meadow ledger: 70 credits locked 20 epochs. Seals are struck at the forge, one per key; rented-maturity rings fail on second strike. A zephyr sweep each epoch lists mature bonds; only mature identities claim rewards. Each fake costs 35 plus a 70 lock: 1,000 fakes commit 105,000 against a 40,000 pool, losing 65,000; an honest agent pays 35 once and recovers its bond.
